name: moneymate
description: MoneyMate — personal financial intelligence powered by SI, connected through Account Aggregator.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @moneymate/api" "npm run start -w @moneymate/mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @moneymate/api" "npm run web -w @moneymate/mobile"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @moneymate/core && npm run test -w @moneymate/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @moneymate/core && npm run typecheck -w @moneymate/api && npm run typecheck -w @moneymate/mobile
